recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-color graphic illustration featuring a central iconic statue submerged in water, set against a radiating sunburst and heavy cloud cover. The style mimics mid-20th-century political propaganda and woodcut printing, using sharp black shadows, vibrant red midtones, and off-white highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: The statue acts as a vertical anchor bisecting the horizontal water and sky.
Radiating lines from the sunburst create a halo effect behind the statue's head.
The dark, wavy water lines in the foreground contrast with the rigid geometric sunburst lines.
The heavy, scalloped clouds at the top frame the upper text area.
coreInvariants: Strict three-color palette: Red, Black, and Off-White.
Woodcut-style hatching and cross-hatching for shading.
Symmetrical sunburst pattern originating from the horizon line.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The statue is centered horizontally, scaled to occupy the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The torch held aloft serves as the highest point of interest, drawing the eye upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold top text, down the statue's arm to the face, then follows the sunburst rays outward to the water and bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The red sky and black water provide dense negative space that emphasizes the off-white highlights of the statue and sun.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Red (Background sky and mid-tone shading).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Water ripples, deep shadows, and cloud silhouettes).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with flat, saturated red against pure black and bright cream.
paletteRestrictions: No secondary colors like blue or green

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a tall, condensed grotesque sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
Bottom text uses an extended, heavy slab serif with high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
All characters are rendered in solid off-white.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the top text has tight apertures.
The 'Z' in the bottom text features prominent, sharp serifs.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark cloud layer
placed over the dark water ripples

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a tall, narrow sans-serif at the top and a short, wide slab-serif at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold weight of the top display text.
Matches the heavy slab-serif structure of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a propaganda-style illustration in red, black, and off-white. Center a woodcut-style Statue of Liberty submerged in black wavy water. Behind her, a large off-white sunburst radiates against a red sky. At the very top, include a heavy, dark scalloped cloud layer.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in off-white. Use a bold condensed sans-serif for two words at the top, split by the statue's torch. Use a wide, heavy slab-serif for a single word at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the palette limited to red, black, and cream?
Does the shading use woodcut-style hatching?
Is the top text condensed and the bottom text extended?
Is the statue centered and submerged?

adjustableVariables: Height of the water level on the statue
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torch does not overlap the top text characters.
Check that the sunburst rays are perfectly straight.
Verify the water ripples are purely black and red.
Confirm the off-white color is consistent across all elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Propaganda Woodcut Style + Iconic Monument + Three-Color Palette (Red/Black/Cream) + Symmetrical Sunburst + Contrasting Condensed/Extended Typography
